newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour says data show inflation not conquered.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour says data show inflation not conquered.

text.p: Figures published on Thursday show that Britain has still not conquered inflation, the opposition Labour Party said.
Data issued earlier showed that retail price inflation was 2.7 percent in November, unchanged from the figure in October.
"(Prime Minister) John Major described last month's inflation figure as a statistical aberration," said Labour Treasury spokesman Alan Milburn. "Today's news makes a mockery of that claim."
"Within just a few months of declaring an economic miracle, the cracks are already appearing. The Tories have not conquered inflation," he added in a statement. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
